governingSources.why: New awareness battles bind immutable policy and record real attempts/unknown usage; no automatic transport retry/fallback and no paid run or deployment are authorized. Stored version dimensions include battle binding format v5 and awareness-v5.

New ordinary battles bind awareness-v5-usage-v2 and one policy through creation, manifest/runtime, dispatch, and provider request; old explicit policies remain unchanged, with no migration or paid call.

awareness-v5 applies only to new battles with immutable policy/prompt/output/asset snapshots; finite failure semantics, narration source coverage, and role ports are required; the orchestrator depends on ports rather than SDK/DB implementations.

startBattle defaults new creation to AwarenessNormalPolicy, routes creation through prepareAwarenessCreationEncounter, and binds BattleAssetManifestV5 with consciousOutputContract awareness-v5 and immutable character generations.
The V5 narration worker requires manifest schema 5 and a runtime, then claims and dispatches ordered frozen narration batches.
